    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    cells = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] == 2]
    r0 = min(r for r, c in cells); r1 = max(r for r, c in cells)
    c0 = min(c for r, c in cells); c1 = max(c for r, c in cells)

        if not any(grid[r][c] not in (0, 2) for r in range(r0)):
            for r in range(r0): out[r][c] = 2
        if not any(grid[r][c] not in (0, 2) for r in range(r1 + 1, h)):
